title: Slovakian Vegan Burger
description: A hearty vegan burger inspired by Slovakian cuisine, made with roasted vegetables and served on a toasted bun.
instructions: Peel and chop the beetroot, carrot, and onion. Toss with oil, salt, and pepper.
Spread the vegetables on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 25 minutes.
Slice the mushrooms and sauté them in a pan until tender.
Prepare the vegan burger patty according to the package instructions.
Assemble the burger by spreading vegan mayo on the bun, adding the roasted vegetables, mushrooms, and vegan patty.
Top with breadcrumbs and serve immediately.
Optional: Grill the burger for an extra crispy texture.
